BrochureContent.Content:
Buona Vista is one of the most impressive fully refurbished town houses ever offered for sale in the very centre of Greystones village. Following a major restoration programme, it has been transformed into a modern energy efficient low maintenance home, whilst retaining all its wonderful original character, charm and period features.

Perfectly positioned in the very heart of Greystones town centre, this beautifully presented three-bedroom Victorian townhouse offers an exceptional opportunity to enjoy coastal living with every conceivable amenity quite literally on its doorstep. Just a gentle stroll from the DART station, South Beach, The Cove and the harbour, the property enjoys one of the most enviable locations in Greystones, surrounded by a wonderful selection of renowned cafés, restaurants and eateries including Chakra, The Hungry Monk, Daata, Las Tapas and Yamas, among many others. The Meridian Centre. Post Office, beauty salons, boutiques, Library, Supermarkets and much more.

Behind its attractive period façade lies a home of immense warmth and character, where elegant period features blend seamlessly with stylish contemporary finishes combining to create a highly energy efficient home having an incredible B1 BER rating. The accommodation which has been lovingly refurbished and upgraded is stunningly presented throughout, showcasing beautiful décor and a wonderful sense of light and space. Original features synonymous with the era have been lovingly retained, including impressive high ceilings adorned with decorative ceiling plasterwork, original panelled doors and an abundance of period charm. These timeless details are perfectly complemented by modern comforts including contemporary bath and shower rooms, quality kitchen fitted cabinetry, air-to-water heating and an enviable BER rating, ensuring both efficiency and comfort for modern living.
Adding further appeal are the lovely sea views and a wonderful front courtyard, providing a private and tranquil outdoor space ideal for al fresco dining, entertaining or simply relaxing. Altogether, this is a rare and highly appealing home that effortlessly combines elegance, convenience and coastal lifestyle in one of Wicklow's most sought-after seaside settings. While located in the centre of the village the house is extremely quiet due to double glazing and high levels of insulation . 

The house has been subject to a total refurbishment with the internal and external replastering of every wall and ceilings, which provided the opportunity to integrate high levels of insulation. The house has new wiring, new plumbing, new central heating, and is in walk-in condition. The house has been recently repainted and has double glazed windows and double glazed French doors. Features include, three bedrooms, kitchen, dining, living area with French doors opening towards the sea. Exceptionally wide upstairs hall with parquet flooring and high ceilings. This beautiful light filled space has been used by the owner as a home office. There are three light filled bedrooms. Other features include electronic access with a video security system providing an exceptional level of security. 
There are no management or services charges.

While located in the centre of the village the house is extremely quiet due to double glazing and high levels of insulation . The house is very private, tucked away at entrance to meridian centre and opposite the side of the village bookshop. Its location is unrivalled for convenience with access to shops, sea, park and trains and bus transportation. Just a short stroll to the beach or marina and all of Greystones' sporting amenities. These include sea swimming, sailing, fishing, kayaking, angling and rugby, soccer, GAA and golf. 

Greystones is renowned for its enviable range of sporting and leisure facilities, including swimming, angling, fishing, boating and water sports, as well as local rugby, GAA, soccer, tennis, hockey and bowling clubs. Three beautiful beaches, Shoreline indoor swimming pool and fitness centre further enhance the area's appeal. Additionally, the town boasts a library, churches of various denominations and highly regarded primary and secondary schools, many within a short walking distance. For golf enthusiasts, several exceptional courses are nearby, including Greystones, Delgany, Druids Heath, Powerscourt and Bray. Transport links are superb, with Greystones DART station, TFI bus routes and easy access to the N11/M50 network, making commuting a breeze.

Viewing is highly recommended.

Entrance: - 
Approached through an electric period iron gate over an oatmeal granite paved courtyard. Slated veranda porch leading to hall door. Sun orientated seating area. Two lantern wall lights.

Entrance Hall - 
With double height ceiling c. 3.6m having decorative cornicing and centre rose, under stairs storage, beautiful, polished walnut timber boarded floor. Waterford Glass chandelier. Video intercom to gate.

Shower Room: - 1.55m x 2.09m
Large shower having glass screen and twin shower heads, tiled surround, W.C. and wash hand basing, vanity mirror, having two wall lights. Recessed downlighters, marble tiled floor.

Utility Room: - 2.62m x 2.09m
Stainless steel sink unit fitted storage combinatory and NIBE unit. Marble tiled floor. Recessed downlighters.

Upstairs: - 
Elegant swan neck wide staircase with mahogany banister to:

Landing: - 
Bright spacious landing, parquet wood flooring and access to attic. Uplighters and pendant light. Large French double door window to Church Road with sea views and two Velux roof lights flooding the space with natural light. Perfect as a study/ home office.

Living /Kitchen/Dining Room: - 3.35m x 5.55m
Dual aspect having large casement double door French windows which are double glazed to the east with sea vista. Decorative ceiling coving, recessed downlighters and pendant lighting, electric log effect fire, double casement glass doors to mistral balcony. KUBE fitted floor and eye level kitchen cabinets, double bowl sink, Normande electric hob and oven with overhead extractor. Integrated dish washer and microwave. Chevron style parquet wood flooring.

Bedroom 1: - 3.35m x 2.62m
Overlooking the courtyard garden, pitched ceiling with Velux roof light and fitted wardrobes.

Bedroom 2: - 3.39m x 2.71m
Dual aspect double room facing Church Road and the Meridian plaza. Carpet flooring. Sea vista.

Bedroom 3: - 3.41m x 2.74m
Looking out to Church Road through tall double casement windows having lovely sea views, fitted wardrobes and carpet flooring.

Bathroom: - 
Feature stained glass door, free standing period enamel bath having brass taps, pedestal “Bayswater” wash hand basin and W.C. recessed downlighters and timber boarded floor. Wall lamps and shaver socket.

Outside: - 
The house is eligible for two residential car parking permits on Church Road. There are very few houses in Greystones with access to residential permit parking on Church Road and this is of great value as for a small annual administrative free this entitles one to unrestricted free parking on Church Road at any time.
